newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends unchanged at Friday's 13.86 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends unchanged at Friday's 13.86 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian tin price ended unchanged at Friday's 13.86 ringgit ($5.51) a kg after both sellers and buyers closed deals at the opening level.
Traders said despite a fall in London on Friday, the local price held steady on good buying interest from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
Turnover was 78 tonnes against 52 tonnes on Friday.
Traders were optimistic that the market would move up to the psychological level of 14 ringgit if demand continues.
The local premium over London market was $80 a tonne from $55 previously.-- Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1-2.5160 rgt)
